Class LightingManager

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.lighting.LightingManager
public final class LightingManager extends Object
Owns the scene's directional sun and ambient light and provides shared sun state.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize(float intensity)
      Adds the sun and ambient lights to the scene and sets the initial sun intensity.
      Parameters:
      intensity - finite, nonnegative multiplier applied to the base sun color

    • setSunDirection

      public void setSunDirection(com.jme3.math.Vector3f direction)
      Changes the direction in which sun rays travel.
      Parameters:
      direction - nonzero world-space ray direction; normalized internally
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the manager has not been initialized
      IllegalArgumentException - if the direction is null or has zero length

    • setSunIntensity

      public void setSunIntensity(float intensity)
      Sets the nonnegative multiplier applied to the base sun color.
      Parameters:
      intensity - finite intensity multiplier
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the manager has not been initialized
      IllegalArgumentException - if the intensity is negative or non-finite

    • getSunDirection

      public com.jme3.math.Vector3f getSunDirection()
      Returns a defensive copy of the normalized direction in which sun rays travel.
      Returns:
      copy of the normalized sun-ray direction
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the manager has not been initialized

    • getSunVersion

      public int getSunVersion()
      Returns the counter incremented whenever setSunDirection(Vector3f) is called. The sky uses it to detect changes without allocating or comparing vectors each frame.
      Returns:
      sun direction change count

    • getSunColor

      public com.jme3.math.ColorRGBA getSunColor()
      Returns a defensive copy of the sun's emitted color, including its intensity multiplier.
      Returns:
      copy of the emitted sun color
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the manager has not been initialized
